household_auth_method_check.name: household_auth_method_check
household_auth_method_check.value: "household_auth"."password_hash" is not null or "household_auth"."google_sub" is not null

households_whatsapp_consent_check.name: households_whatsapp_consent_check
households_whatsapp_consent_check.value: ("households"."whatsapp_e164" is null and "households"."whatsapp_consent_at" is null) or ("households"."whatsapp_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$' and "households"."whatsapp_consent_at" is not null)

registration_payments_confirmation_check.name: registration_payments_confirmation_check
registration_payments_confirmation_check.value: ("registration_payments"."status" = 'pending' and "registration_payments"."confirmed_by" is null and "registration_payments"."confirmed_at" is null) or ("registration_payments"."status" = 'confirmed' and "registration_payments"."confirmed_by" is not null and "registration_payments"."confirmed_at" is not null)

registration_performances_duration_check.name: registration_performances_duration_check
registration_performances_duration_check.value: ("registration_performances"."participant_count" = 1 and "registration_performances"."duration_minutes" between 1 and 4) or ("registration_performances"."participant_count" between 2 and 4 and "registration_performances"."duration_minutes" between 1 and 5) or ("registration_performances"."participant_count" >= 5 and "registration_performances"."duration_minutes" between 1 and 7)

registrations_whatsapp_consent_check.name: registrations_whatsapp_consent_check
registrations_whatsapp_consent_check.value: ("registrations"."contact_whatsapp_e164" is null and "registrations"."whatsapp_consent_at" is null) or ("registrations"."contact_whatsapp_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$' and "registrations"."whatsapp_consent_at" is not null)
